craft_notes: Sthāyin: rescue. Sanskrit-first: atikṛpālu kept. Rows: 2. Close: ground. Rejected: pomp — killed: shed by text. Read aloud: pitying cadence.

lines: Pity rites where pomp is banned.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kāryā teṣāmihāntyeṣṭirguruṇātikṛpālunā | na maṇḍalādikaṃ tvatra bhavecchamāśānike vidhau
